title: ἀλλήλων: one another
subtitle: Read reciprocal relationships in plural clauses.
overview: ἀλλήλων is reciprocal: it describes members of a plural group acting toward each other.
It normally occurs outside the nominative; let its case show the relation required by the verb or preposition.

items.grc: ἐν τούτῳ γνώσονται πάντες ὅτι ἐμοὶ μαθηταί ἐστε, ἐὰν ἀγάπην ἔχητε ἐν ἀλλήλοις.
items.en: By this all will know that you are my disciples, if you have love among one another.
